onePage.pathLegend: How would you like to order?
onePage.finalStepHint: Once you have entered your address, you will see the final price including shipping and can place your order.

rcCheckout.enquiryHint: Unfortunately we cannot deliver this cart by our regular shipping route. Please contact us for an individual solution — we will get back to you as soon as possible.
rcCheckout.enquiryHintPickupOnly: This basket cannot be shipped. Please get in touch — we will arrange collection or delivery with you personally.
rcCheckout.enquiryCartTaken: Your cart has been carried over. You can add to the text below before sending.
rcCheckout.enquiryIntro:
Dear Sir or Madam,

unfortunately I was told that this cart cannot be shipped as it stands. I would be glad to receive an individual quote.

Kind regards
rcCheckout.pickupHint: You have chosen to collect your order yourself. Please make sure you are able to transport the goods. Your cart weighs {weight} in total and its longest item measures {length}.
rcCheckout.pickupHintWeightOnly: You have chosen to collect your order yourself. Please make sure you are able to transport the goods. Your cart weighs {weight} in total.
rcCheckout.pickupHintLengthOnly: You have chosen to collect your order yourself. Please make sure you are able to transport the goods. The longest item in your cart measures {length}.
rcCheckout.pickupDialogConfirm: Understood — I will collect it myself
rcCheckout.pickupDialogError: The confirmation could not be saved. Please reload the page and try again.
rcCheckout.pickupDocumentNote: Collection in person: loading and transport of the goods are the buyer’s responsibility.
rcCheckout.phoneNumberHint: Your phone number is still missing for this order. We need it for questions about the delivery — the carrier will call you before delivering.
rcCheckout.phoneNumberSaved: Thank you, your phone number has been saved.
rcCheckout.phoneNumberInvalid: That does not look like a phone number. Please enter it including the area code, for example 09568 8039770.

guestAccount.heading: Turn this order into a customer account
guestAccount.info: Your details from this order are already here. Choose a password and from now on log in with %email% to see your orders in your account.
guestAccount.created: Your customer account has been created. Log in with %email% and your new password.
guestAccount.expired: The offer to create a customer account has expired. You can register at any time.
guestAccount.emailTaken: There is already a customer account for this email address. Please log in there; if you have forgotten the password, use "Forgot password".
guestAccount.invalidPassword: The password is too short or the confirmation does not match. Please use at least %minLength% characters.

freeShipping.achieved: Congratulations — your order will be shipped for free!
freeShipping.remainingWithin: Only %amount% to go for free shipping to %countries%!

shippingEstimate.title: Estimate shipping costs for this cart
shippingEstimate.zipHint: Required. The postcode affects the price.
shippingEstimate.caption: Shipping methods
shippingEstimate.noShipping: We cannot offer a shipping method for this cart — this may be due to the destination country or to the weight and dimensions of the items.
shippingEstimate.failed: Shipping costs cannot be determined right now. Please try again later.

shippingPlaceholder.costs: calculated once you enter your delivery address

offcanvasShipping.stale: The cart has changed — shipping costs need to be recalculated.
